research_question: Does a causal bearish-to-bullish market-structure reversal have positive net expectancy on NEARUSDT 1h?
mechanism: A sequence of lower lows followed by higher lows and higher highs may indicate that selling pressure has weakened and buyers have taken control. The pattern has no independently established economic edge.
falsifier: Non-positive mean net trade return at the 10 bps per-side base cost, or failure of the observed sequence to produce positive forward expectancy. Results remain descriptive with one instrument and one historical period.

data.warmup: History before interval start may initialize ATR and pivot state; outcomes are limited to requested interval.

frozen_rules.atr: Wilder ATR14, recursive alpha=1/14, initialized with first true range
frozen_rules.pivot: Causal reversal state machine. A candidate trough is confirmed when a bar close is at least 1.0 times ATR14 at the candidate trough above its low. A candidate peak is confirmed when a bar close is at least 1.0 times ATR14 at the candidate peak below its high. Use close for confirmation to avoid intrabar order ambiguity.
frozen_rules.classification: Compare each confirmed pivot with the previous confirmed pivot of the same type; classify LL, HL, LH, HH.
frozen_rules.sequence: At least two consecutive confirmed LL; first HL; first HH after that HL; next HL; next HH. Signal is available only on confirmation of the second HH. One signal per completed sequence; overlapping or repeated signals while positioned are ignored.
frozen_rules.entry: Signal at close t, fill at open t+1; long 100% equity notional, no leverage or pyramiding.
frozen_rules.exit: Exit when a later confirmed swing low is below the setup's second HL, or after 48 bars held. Decision at close, fill at next open. Liquidate at final available close if still open; label end-of-sample liquidation.
frozen_rules.event_study: Forward close-to-close returns from signal close at 5, 10, 20 and 40 bars, diagnostic only.

costs.basis: Exploratory all-in placeholder. No historical NEAR-specific fee, spread or slippage evidence was found in the repository.

evaluation.selection: No parameter sweep or optimization. Stress costs are diagnostics, not selection trials.

baseline: Buy and hold over the same requested bars, entry at first open and final liquidation at last close, with the same per-side costs.

skill_selection.name: ml4t-lookahead-bias
skill_selection.reason: Pivots and sequence confirmation must not use future information.
skill_selection.invariant: Only confirmed information is available at signal close; order fills next bar.
skill_selection.verification: Causal state-machine tests and append-future invariance test.

skill_selection.name: ml4t-compute-features
skill_selection.reason: ATR and pivots are sequential price features.
skill_selection.invariant: Sorted OHLCV input; ATR uses current and past bars only.

skill_selection.name: ml4t-run-backtest
skill_selection.reason: Next-bar execution, explicit position state and costs are required.
skill_selection.invariant: No same-bar fills; one long position; costs on every fill; daily equity Sharpe.

skill_selection.name: ml4t-transaction-costs
skill_selection.reason: No exact historical execution-cost evidence was available.
skill_selection.invariant: State exploratory cost assumptions and sensitivity; include all-in friction per side.
skill_selection.verification: Report 10/20/30 bps per-side cases and limitations.
